description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian man in his early 40s, serving as a police inspector. He has a clean-shaven face and short, neat black hair. He is wearing a formal dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver buttons, visible insignia on the shoulders, and a tucked-in shirt. He is wearing dark trousers and polished black shoes.

FULL BODY. An elderly Malaysian woman in her late 60s. She has a gentle face with visible aging. She is wearing a traditional floral-patterned Baju Kurung in soft pastel colors and a matching simple headscarf (tudung). She wears modest flat sandals and a small gold watch on her wrist.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human silhouette representing a scammer. The figure is entirely black and void of facial features, wearing a dark hooded sweatshirt with the hood pulled up. A subtle digital green glow outlines the edges of the silhouette to represent a cyber-criminal nature.
